title: Website staging
description: Stages a branch on a *.staged.apache.org preview domain. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#staging

whoami.description: Branch to stage from. Staging only happens when this matches the current branch.

hostname.description: Accepted but unused. The staging hostname is always inferred from the repository.

profile.description: Staging profile, used as part of the *.staged.apache.org domain. May not contain dots. Set to null (~) for the default profile.

autostage.description: Branch glob to auto-stage with a dynamic profile, e.g. site/*. Must end with /*. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#autostage
